example: sava lakh = 1.25 lakh = 1,25,000; sava do = 2.25 (quarter more than N, default N=1 when unit stated alone)
dedh lakh = 1.5 lakh = 1,50,000. Fixed word for 1.5; NOT a generalizable modifier (no productive 'dedh do').

paune lakh = 0.75 lakh = 75,000; paune do = 1.75 (quarter less than N, default N=1 when unit stated alone). Etymology पदून = 'less by a quarter'; Wiktionary examples 'paune das sau'=975, 'paune ek hazaar'=750 confirm the (N-0.25) pattern.
adhai/dhai lakh = 2.5 lakh = 2,50,000. Fixed word for 2.5; NOT a generalizable modifier. Both 'dhai' and 'adhai' transliterations are in use.
